description: MEGALOWMART’s bamboo utensils and holder set is perfect for your cooking, mixing, and serving needs. These wood kitchen tools are made with natural bamboo and include our 90-Day Money Back Guarantee.

What grass is so strong it has been trusted for centuries to make everything from kitchen utensils to furniture, to even building homes? The answer is bamboo! Bamboo is actually a grass, not a wood, that is versatile, aesthetically pleasing, and green. Hollow yet sturdy, bamboo is hardy and able to grow in almost any environment. Why change something that is naturally beautiful and strong?

MEGALOWMART believes in products that look good and simply work. Bring the raw beauty, lightweight strength, and natural color of bamboo into your kitchen today. And if those are not enough reasons to love bamboo, check out these facts below:

SUSTAINABILITY- Grows like grass because it is a grass! Bamboo is the fastest growing plant on the planet – Up to 3 feet per day – Making it a great renewable resource - Bamboo is found all over the world, and its deep-growing roots cause less soil erosion and allow the next generation of plants to grow in quickly - Bamboo production provides jobs for families in rural communities

STRENGTH- Strong yet lightweight - Firm and flexible: Bamboo’s deep-rooted foundation makes it sturdy, and its fibers and segmented structure allow it to bend and withstand a lot of stress - Simply put, bamboo products are durable and if properly cared for, will last for many years

NATURAL BEAUTY- Bamboo grows tall, simply, and beautifully in almost any soil condition - Requires no fertilizers, pesticides, or herbicides to help it grow - Eco-friendly without sacrificing quality or style
